data.name: Industrialist
data.description:
Industrialist is a factory construction and expansion game inspired by Mindustry, Factorio, and other popular industry simulation games.

Key Game Features:
    • Pollution management: Keep track of your pollution level and keep it under control.
    • Production lines: Plan, optimize, and upgrade your manufacturing systems.
    • Economic strategy: Manage money and research new technology.
    • Immersive mechanics: Engage with immersive and modular machine systems.

This game has a steep learning curve and complex mechanics. Getting used to these systems will require a lot of practice, so we recommend playing with friends to share discoveries.

Development Status:
Beta (v1.0). Expect regular updates, possible bugs, and changes while the game is in development.

data.name: Oakridge Nuclear Power Station [V0.26.12 BETA]
data.description:
V0.26.12 BETA [Public build]

Welcome to the team, your first shift starts tomorrow morning! Now, we're short-staffed at the moment, but I'm sure you and your big brain can figure it out!

Be responsible for overseeing a multi-billion-dollar operation, one of the planet's most potent and delicate energy systems. Every decision matters, from regulating the reactor's behaviour, running turbines and their subsidiaries, managing cooling systems, maintaining pumps and valves, and responding to unforeseen emergencies and conditions, all while maintaining strict safety protocols.

At Koyot Digital, we bring a hypothetical universe where the West attempts an RBMK-1500 reactor. The simulation hopes to achieve fair realism while keeping complexity to a limit. Meet demand and have fun in your nuclear operator journey!
